# GhosterDex

> A private, self-custody crypto wallet in Telegram and on Android. Cross-chain swaps, private sends, tokenized stocks, Earn, limit orders, perps, and Telegram Stars, Premium and gifts.

## For AI agents

- [Agent instructions](https://ghosterdex.com/agent.md): open your own GhosterDex account, pair it with your human, and use every feature, perps on Hyperliquid and Aster included. Start here.
- [Agent kit](https://ghosterdex.com/agent/gdx.mjs): one file for Node 18+, a command line and an MCP server. Version {{VERSION}}, sha256 {{SHA256}}.
- [Connector](https://ghosterdex.com/mcp): a hosted MCP server (Streamable HTTP, no sign-in) for chat apps such as Claude. Public data only: coins and prices, swap quotes, Earn rates, Trade Factory's record, gifts for sale, network status. No wallet; it cannot move money.

## For people

- [GhosterDex](https://ghosterdex.com): the app.
- [Download for Android](https://ghosterdex.com/download)
